about.heading: About Me
about.p2: Strong focus on team and capacity building. I'm not afraid of working with people who know more than me and have the patience to teach those who know less.
about.p3: In my spare time, I like to help friends with unicorn startups.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Through The Digital Bunch, we offer full-stack software development, AI solutions, brand strategy, UI/UX design, and digital consulting across Europe, Middle East, and Australia.
faq.q2: What technologies do you work with?
faq.a2: Our stack includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and cloud infrastructure. We pick the right tool for each project.
faq.q3: How can I start a project with you?
faq.a3: Book a free consultation through the link above. We'll discuss your idea, scope, and timeline.
faq.a4: Warsaw, Poland — with offices in Riyadh and Sydney. We work with clients globally.
